**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

## Episode Thesis

Interview with Samuel Slotte, head of sustainable finance at Danske Bank, on the bank's plan to more than quintuple its transition financing from DKK 18bn to DKK 100bn by 2028, despite the Northvolt collapse, ESG backlash and more cautious investors. The guest calls it a commercial rather than political goal and admits the transition will be a bumpy ride with many companies running into trouble. He is positive on grid, electrification, heavy industry and heat production, backs keeping the EU ETS, and argues that geopolitics and energy-independence goals are speeding up the transition. No investment recommendations on specific stocks were given.
